candidates.title: HYDRA: A Heterogeneous Chiplet DSE Framework for Serving Dynamic Hybrid LLM Workloads
candidates.reason: Recent hardware/software co-design for hybrid Transformer-Mamba serving, jointly exploring chiplet composition, placement, bandwidth, batching and scheduling; reports 1.55x average throughput and 43.7% lower TTFT.

candidates.title: ARK: Avoiding Routing Collisions for KV Cache Transfer in Disaggregated LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Directly targets network contention from large KV-cache transfers in disaggregated prefill/decode serving; distributed path reservation cuts P95 flow completion time up to 34.0% and mean TTFT up to 12.9%.

candidates.title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training
candidates.reason: Phase-aware memory management and cross-TP weight sharing for VLM RL post-training; on 32 H800s reports 1.23-1.30x over serial colocation and 1.57-2.24x over disaggregation.

candidates.title: TideRL: Boosting Agentic RL Goodput with Readiness-Aware Scheduling
candidates.reason: Readiness-aware scheduling for multi-turn agentic RL with preserved rollout state and elastic resources; improves training goodput up to 5.6x, KV-cache hit rate 1.58x, and cuts waiting time up to 77.6%.

candidates.title: ImpactHO: Importance-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Multi-User Edge LLM Handover
candidates.reason: Turns token-level KV importance into communication savings for edge handover under constrained backhaul; achieves over 93.7% average accuracy in a 500 ms transfer window and 98.2-99.5% of a clairvoyant upper bound.
